description: This file contains implementation code for managing Wi-Fi hostapd interfaces in a Linux-based embedded system, including functions for configuring, controlling, and querying hostapd instances and associated access points within a wireless radio context.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlInterface_t * s_getFirstReadyIface(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Retrieves the first ready WPA control interface for a given radio.

methods.name: bool s_sendHostapdCommand(T_Radio * pR,char * cmd,const char * reason)
methods.description: Sends a command to hostapd via the first ready interface and checks for response.

methods.name: swl_bit32_t wld_rad_calculateDisabledSubchannelsBitmap(T_Radio * pR,swl_chanspec_t * pChSpec)
methods.description: Calculates a bitmap of disabled subchannels based on current radio configuration.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_action_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_setOperatingStandard(T_Radio * pRadio)
methods.description: Updates the operating standard in hostapd and triggers reload if changed.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_calculateSecChannelOffset(swl_bandwidth_e bandwidth,uint32_t freq,uint32_t center_freq,int * sec_channel_offset)
methods.description: Determines the secondary channel offset parameter for channel switching based on bandwidth and frequencies.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_switchChannel(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Switches the radio to a new channel with specified parameters.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_reload(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Reloads hostapd configuration.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_reconfigure(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Reconfigures hostapd from its configuration file.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_action_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_setChannel(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Sets radio channel parameters in hostapd.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_action_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_setMiscParams(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Sets miscellaneous parameters in hostapd configuration.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_enable(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Enables the main hostapd interface.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_updateAllVapsConfigId(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Updates the configuration ID for all VAPs (Virtual APs).

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_updateMaxNumStations(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Updates maximum station count for all VAPs.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_disable(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Disables the main hostapd interface.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_addConf(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Adds radio and VAP configuration to hostapd.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_removeConf(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Removes radio and VAP configuration from hostapd.

methods.name: swl_trl_e wld_rad_hostapd_getCfgParamSupp(T_Radio * pRad,const char * param)
methods.description: Checks if a configuration parameter is supported by hostapd.

methods.name: bool s_isApLoaded(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Checks if an AP is loaded and connected by hostapd.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getFirstConnectedVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Returns the first connected and loaded VAP.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getSavedMainVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Retrieves the main VAP from the saved configuration.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getCfgMainVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Determines the main VAP based on support and connection status.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getRunMainVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Gets the main VAP currently running based on interface status.

methods.name: bool wld_rad_hostapd_hasActiveApMld(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t minNLinks)
methods.description: Checks whether the radio has active MLD (Multiple Link Device) APs.
